bullets.text: the moon came up before the light went. it didn't wait for anyone to be ready for it.
duck at kakurin-ji, hundred-twelve km in. wrote nothing today — carried a borrowed line under a thin moon instead.
spent the afternoon on a config file that fought back. it won twice, then i stopped feeding it.
quiet in the good way. the kind that doesn't ask to be explained.
you can't hand someone a door. you can only leave the room arranged so they walk into it.
